title: The Debian family: apt and PPAs

sync.text: Download the latest package lists with `apt update`.
sync.hint: The command changes the system and requires root: `sudo apt update`.

upgrade.hint: After `sudo apt update`, run `sudo apt upgrade`.

forbered.text: Make sure you have the command `add-apt-repository`. It is in the package `software-properties-common` – preinstalled on Ubuntu, but not on Debian.
forbered.hint: `sudo apt update` and then `sudo apt install software-properties-common`.

lagg-till.hint: `sudo add-apt-repository ppa:lunatool/moonphase` – and press Enter when it asks.

granska.text: Look inside the file that `add-apt-repository` created in `/etc/apt/sources.list.d/`.
granska.hint: `ls /etc/apt/sources.list.d` and then `cat` the file whose name starts with `lunatool`.

installera.text: Install the package `moonphase` from the PPA.
installera.hint: `add-apt-repository` already ran `apt update` for you, so `sudo apt install moonphase` is enough.

efterat.text: Remove the PPA again. The program stays, but gets no more updates.

vim.text: Bonus: install the Vim text editor.
vim.hint: Search with `apt search vim`. The package is called `vim`.
